automation.assessment: DefaultDoseComplianceEvaluatorTest already covers the insulin branch in isolation with firings shaped like the rule's real output (SC/IV match and mismatch). Nothing in qa-suite asserts the persisted compliance verdict end to end, and the whole path is reachable without a browser: admin staging, tenant-user POST /api/cds/medication-selection, tenant-user POST medication-administration with the returned trackingTabId, then admin GET /api/admin/rule/evaluations/fired which already carries complianceResults. Worth one supplemental INS pair that locks in the wiring the unit test cannot see (tracking-id linkage and the afterCommit re-evaluation).
